Name: Fishing Info Overlays - fix 1.6
Author: cyxyr
Description:
[b][color=#ff0000]The original mod is being fixed, this mod stopped updating[/color].[url=https://github.com/barteke22/StardewMods/issues/3#issuecomment-2056887837]Beta link[/url]
[/b][color=#ff0000]原mod正在修复，这个mod停止更新[/color][b].[url=https://github.com/barteke22/StardewMods/issues/3#issuecomment-2056887837]测试版[/url][/b]

This mod background calls the game's fishing minigame to calculate the probability, and the result should be the same for the player fishing. 
这个mod后台调用游戏的钓鱼小游戏来计算概率，结果应该玩家钓鱼是相同的。

If a fish that is not in the current location is displayed, maybe your BarScanRadius value is too large, or the season or time of the （mod）fish is not set correctly
如果显示了不是当前位置的鱼，可能你的BarScanRadius值太大，或者（mod）相关的鱼的季节或时间没有设置正确

I updated it and there was no problem with my local test, but the test time was too short and there may be some bugs
我更新了它，我的本地测试没有问题，但是测试时间太短，可能存在一些错误

deleted the local multiscreen feature
删除了本地分屏下的显示功能

If you notice any issues, let me know :) ,   Other mod compatible display problems, please reply with mod name
如果有问题，可以及时反馈，其他mod兼容显示问题，请回复带上mod名

The original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8970] Fishing Info Overlays [/url] , If the original author does not allow distribution, please contact me to delete
原mod链接，如果原作者不允许分发，请联系我删除该页面

Manifest.Name: Fishing Info Overlays
Manifest.Description: Adds a preview showing fish in current location when holding a fishing rod, which fish you're currently catching, and more!
Manifest.Author: barteke22
